title:
Law, evidence,
and emerging technology.
lead: A law graduate from Renmin University of China with a professional legal qualification in China, currently studying at the University of Melbourne. My current interests centre on legal reasoning, AI alignment, trustworthy AI, and the practical relationship between artificial intelligence and law.

entries.title: Evaluating Legal Reasoning Under Prior-Answer Influence
entries.body: Studying how prior answers affect legal reasoning, evidence use, and the reliability of model evaluation.

entries.title: Research on Child Testimony and Corroboration
entries.meta: Undergraduate thesis · Renmin University of China
entries.body: Completed a thesis on the evidentiary value and corroboration of child testimony in cases involving crimes against children.

entries.title: Judicial Assistant Internship
entries.body: Supported retrial and civil first-instance case management, judicial-document review, file organisation, and case-law research.
